answer_2.quote: Our model received a micro averaged F1 score of 0.5, with an averaged precision of 0.42 and averaged recall of 0.62. ... The proportion of non-zero intersection instances between the model and human annotations is 84.2% ... We compute Krippendorff's alpha (α = 0.393) and mean Jaccard Index (0.614) as measures of inter-annotator agreement.

answer_4.quote: Two of the authors manually annotated 600 images for generic frames ... We compute Krippendorff's alpha (α = 0.393) and mean Jaccard Index (0.614) as measures of inter-annotator agreement. ... We tested their coherence with intruder-test, a test typically used for evaluation of open-ended output like topics, with 3 annotators. Annotators identified the intruder frames 89.5%, 94.7% and 100% of the time.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed annotation guidelines for selecting one or more frames per image and performed an intruder-test where a random frame was replaced by an intruder and annotators identified it.
